name: nazovportalu-app
description: Mobilná aplikácia NazovPortalu (Capacitor) – iOS a Android nad spoločným Supabase backendom

scripts.sync: npm run build && npx cap sync
scripts.android: npm run sync && npx cap open android
scripts.ios: npm run sync && npx cap open ios
scripts.run:android: npm run sync && npx cap run android
scripts.run:ios: npm run sync && npx cap run ios
scripts.release:android: npm run sync && cd android && ./gradlew bundleRelease
